name: Short Cut Cream of Asparagus Soup with Dill & Crackers

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and place leaves in a medium saucepan.

Drain asparagus and add to the pan with the dill along with broth, cream, salt, and pepper. Using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pan.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (14.5 oz) can asparagus spears, canned
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 cup heavy whipping cream
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Set soup over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until soup is just simmering, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with crackers on the side. Enjoy!
